instructions: Cut the cabbage in half and thinly shred one half. That should be about 6 cups. Wrap the other half for another meal.
Transfer the cabbage to a large bowl, add the salt, and rub it in with your hands for about 1 minute, until the cabbage starts to soften.
Pick the mint leaves, stack them, and slice them thin. Add 1/4 cup to the cabbage.
Juice the lemon into a small bowl and whisk in the olive oil. Pour it over the cabbage and toss well.
Taste it, and add a pinch more salt if it's flat. Serve right away, or pack it for lunch. For packing, keep the dressing in a small jar and toss it in just before you eat.
method_notes: Simply Lebanese (4.88 from 8 ratings) is the only readable version, so the ratios are its: about 6 cups of cabbage, 1/3 cup olive oil, 1 lemon, 1 tsp salt and fresh mint. Other pages in the search add garlic, scallions or za'atar and rub the salt in; the salt rub is here. The lead says the salad wilts and is best the same day, so the 'keeps all week' note is only true for undressed cabbage: shredded cabbage keeps in the fridge for 3 or 4 days, dressed cabbage is best within a day.
